title: RDW–globulin coupling does not establish improved CRP prediction beyond routine inflammatory measures in separate NHANES samples
abstract: A fixed RDW×globulin interaction tested whether erythrocyte heterogeneity contextualizes serum protein signals beyond flexible routine laboratory measures and existing ratios. In NHANES2005–06 adults20–79(n=4049) models were fitted and frozen for separately sampled2007–08(n=4864). Examination-weighted natural-log-CRP MSE changed from 1.008172 to 1.007767;baseline-minus-augmented gain 0.000405,500 joint source-refit/targetPSU-bootstrap95% interval[-0.005345,0.003096]. This narrow representation test does not establish benefit or equivalence. Separate survey releases provide limited sample transfer,not independent health-system validation.
